items.exampleEn: The waiter was sloppy and brought us the wrong drinks.
items.exampleZh: 那位服務生做事草率，送錯了我們的飲料。

items.exampleEn: This fish is very bony, so eat it carefully.
items.exampleZh: 這條魚刺很多，要小心吃。

items.exampleEn: The garden pool is rectangular, not round.
items.exampleZh: 花園的水池是長方形的，不是圓的。

items.exampleEn: He wore tan pants and a white shirt.
items.exampleZh: 他穿著黃褐色的長褲和白襯衫。

items.exampleEn: The plastic flowers on the table looked unnatural.
items.exampleZh: 桌上的塑膠花看起來很不自然。

items.exampleEn: The river is visibly cleaner than it was last year.
items.exampleZh: 這條河明顯比去年乾淨。

items.exampleEn: The flight was turbulent, so we kept our seat belts on.
items.exampleZh: 飛行途中氣流不穩，所以我們一直繫著安全帶。

items.exampleEn: The mayor laid the cornerstone of the new library.
items.exampleZh: 市長為新圖書館奠下基石。

items.sentenceEn: Honesty is the cornerstone of a good team.

items.audioEn: The sea was turbulent this morning, so the boat trip has been moved to tomorrow.
items.audioZh: 今天早上海象很不穩，所以搭船行程改到明天。
options: It was put off for a day
It left early in the morning
It was moved to the afternoon

items.sentenceEn: Her painting looked unnatural because the colors were too bright.
items.sentenceZh: 她的畫因為顏色太鮮豔而顯得不自然。

items.sentenceEn: The old horse has become thin and bony.
items.sentenceZh: 那匹老馬變得又瘦又皮包骨。

items.stemEn: The kitchen table is ____, about two meters long and one meter wide.
items.stemZh: 廚房的桌子是長方形的，大約兩公尺長、一公尺寬。

items.stemEn: The singer was ____ upset when the crowd started to leave.
items.stemZh: 觀眾開始離場時，那位歌手明顯很難過。

items.passageEn: After two weeks at a summer camp by the lake, my brother came home with a deep tan and a bag full of dirty clothes. He said the first few days were turbulent: it rained every afternoon, and the wind knocked down two tents. The leaders were strict, and sloppy work in the kitchen meant extra cleaning. On the last day, they went on an excursion across the lake on a rectangular wooden boat they had built. He was visibly proud when he told us about it.
items.passageZh: 在湖邊的夏令營待了兩週後，我的兄弟曬得黝黑地回家，還帶了一袋髒衣服。他說頭幾天很混亂：每天下午都下雨，風還吹倒了兩頂帳篷。輔導員很嚴格，廚房工作做得草率就得額外打掃。最後一天，他們搭著自己做的長方形木船到湖對岸遠足。他跟我們講這件事時，看得出來非常得意。

questions.questionZh: 夏令營頭幾天發生了什麼事？
options: 作者的兄弟生病一直待在帳篷裡

questions.questionZh: 廚房工作做得草率會怎樣？

items.promptZh: 他的報告寫得很草率，錯誤百出。
referenceEn: His report was sloppy and full of mistakes.
He wrote a sloppy report with lots of mistakes.
rubricZh: 要用 sloppy（例如 was sloppy、a sloppy report）
「錯誤百出」可寫，例如 full of mistakes、with lots of mistakes 等

items.promptZh: 要小孩子整天坐著不動，是不自然的。
referenceEn: It is unnatural for young children to sit still all day.
Sitting still all day is unnatural for young children.
rubricZh: unnatural 表示「不自然的、違反天性的」，句型例如 It is unnatural for… to…、Sitting … is unnatural 等
「坐著不動」可寫，例如 sit still 等
「小孩子」可寫，例如 young children、little kids 等
